Locator L1 (Results; for: Triac maintenance dose in children and adults with MCT8 deficiency): "The median maintenance dose was 38 µg/kg/day (interquartile range, 31-61 µg/kg/day; range, 15-105 µg/kg/day)."
Locator L2 (Results; for: Safety over up to 6 years in a retrospective off-label cohort): "No severe adverse events related to Triac were reported during follow-up."

Locator L3 (Results; for: Thyrotoxic signs on Triac): "Transient signs of increased thyrotoxicosis (increased irritability and anxiety, reduced sleep, increase in blood pressure, and tachycardia) were reported in a small subset of patients (5 of 67 patients; Supplementary Table 4)."

Locator L4 (Discussion, limitations; for: No neurodevelopmental outcome in the real-life cohort): "this study precludes determining the optimal Triac dose for MCT8 deficiency for both the peripheral and neurocognitive phenotype as data on neurodevelopmental outcomes had not been uniformly collected"

Locator L5 (Results; for: Deaths and discontinuations (causes in line with natural history per the authors)): "During the study period, 3 patients died and 10 other patients discontinued Triac therapy"
